subject: [PATCH v5 4/7] mm/page_counter: use stock in page_counter_try_charge

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the page_counter_try_charge function to attempt to service a charge request from its stock before attempting to fulfill it through the hierarchy. The patch preserves the existing semantics of stock management, including limiting checks and greedy attempts to refill the stock. It also adds a new function, page_counter_refill_stock, which is used by page_counter_try_charge to refill the stock. No functional changes are intended as no page counters currently enable stock and counter->batch remains at 0.
